notes: AC1 is repo-wide; only web gates were run because T3/W2 are in progress in parallel.
AC17's named check is ProfileView.test.ts (owned by W2); W3 adds its own plain-text test in EditProfileView.test.ts and uses no v-html.
Save payload is built explicitly as { displayName, bio, location (null when blank), links } in display order, via session.saveProfile.
API issue paths 'body/links/1/url' are mapped to keys 'links.1.url'; the form also shows the API message.
AvatarUpload calls session.saveAvatar/deleteAvatar itself and emits 'changed'; client rejects non JPEG/PNG/WebP and files over MAX_AVATAR_BYTES before any request.
LinksEditor uses index keys (ProfileLinkInput has no id); add() returns early at MAX_PROFILE_LINKS and the Add button is disabled.
Tests mock fetch; the avatar endpoints (T3) were not exercised against a real API.
